questions.question: After int a=5; int b=a; b++; what are a and b?
options: Both refer to one mutable object
questions.explanation: Primitive assignment copies the value into an independent variable.

questions.question: After int[] x={1,2}; int[] y=x; y[0]=8; what is x[0]?
questions.explanation: Both variables contain the same array reference, so the mutation is visible through x.

questions.question: Why does double result = 7 / 2 store 3.0?
questions.explanation: The right-hand expression is evaluated first using two int operands.

questions.question: Which generic declaration is legal?
questions.explanation: Generic arguments must be reference types; Integer is the wrapper for int.
